entry_state: Portable operations use the common envelope and closed signature arguments, preserve exact record and byte dependencies, and distinguish candidate construction, admission, selection and commit. Corporate and joined-company packages retain their finite scopes, exact retry histories and explicit partial answers. Assess-only treatment cannot grant posting permission; authorization, proposal and atomic commit have separate inputs and results. The remaining registry must preserve these boundaries through reporting, uncertainty and the financing profile.
exit_state: The operation reference preserves pure reporting and explanation, semantically unchanged resume, verified import/export and constrained migration. Closed accounting records bind the exact basis, authorization, journal and independent delta. OrderedEPS/1 binds complete inventory, context, additive scope, signed earnings and nonoverlapping potential/actual windows, with independently usable basic EPS when dilution remains blocked. CompanyEPSJoin/1 derives and checks the complete company projection; its maturity-only exchange remains separate from Section 10.2.6's bounded unchanged-original-right early conversion.

findings.judgment: Reporting preserves joint branches without a balancing plug; explanation uses the frozen view and explicit depth truncation. Resume retains the original semantic manifest. Export may be explicitly incomplete, import verifies before metadata transaction and grants no financial admission, and migration cannot disguise a changed model as a format change. The closed-record introduction rejects unknown fields and permits empty support sets only under an explained admitted assumption scope.

AccountingEventBasis, PostingAuthorization and AccountingCommitArguments expose exact references rather than hiding state in a generic payload. Eligible status alone is constrained by supported profile and immutable synthetic/real book mode; synthetic evidence cannot authorize real posting. Journal and independent delta point to basis and authorization without a forward cycle to the receipt. MethodDefinition requires state/event/journal/delta schemas, preconditions, algorithm, mappings and unsupported cases; false and unknown preconditions differ, and registering a schema does not establish applicability.

OrderedEPS/1 states its independent additive fixed-effect scope, complete series inventory, exact context hash and reduced-rational representation. Signed earnings increments remain permitted while share increments are positive and already weighted. Potential and actual windows are positive, disjoint and ordered for conversion, with actual shares included in basic EPS. Unresolved and unsupported series are retained rather than silently dropped. Continuing-profit ordering, exact-ratio ties and independently ready basic EPS survive blocked dilution; structural rejection takes precedence and no mutation is possible.

CompanyEPSJoin/1 binds the preserved source packet, supplied premises and a head derived from complete legal books. It recomputes tax, journals, daily share history and consolidated ordinary earnings before comparing the proposed EPS context and weighted denominator. A failed company input nulls both results, whereas a rejected EPS projection can retain the independently derived company result. The closing paragraph visibly points to Section 10.2.6 and expressly keeps this exchange at maturity, so the bounded early-conversion policy does not silently broaden the joined operation.
